_about: Public job boards for companies whose own career page cannot reveal them to an unattended client (403 to automation, client-rendered from a private API, or a stale URL). Keyed by identity.name_key. Each entry was verified live against the board's public API; detection still records it as evidence, and a failing board shows as FAILED like any other source.

salesforce.evidence: careers.salesforce.com returns 403 to automation; its public Workday board listed 1,506 postings

zillow.evidence: The seed URL returns 404; Zillow's public Workday board listed 137 postings

snap.evidence: careers.snap.com renders from a private API; Snap's public Workday board listed 201 postings

atandt.evidence: AT&T's public Workday board listed 1,126 postings

ebay.evidence: jobs.ebayinc.com renders client-side; eBay's public Workday board listed 293 postings

temporaltechnologies.evidence: Temporal Technologies' Ashby board 'temporal' listed 66 postings
